title: Calculate cumulative losses and credits
scenario: Irvani Quality records 50 fictitious COPQ events in chronological source order. Positive CAD values are costs and negative values are recovery credits. Net loss retains credits; gross cost deliberately excludes them. No cells are missing.

lesson.intro: SCAN exposes the running accumulation after each event. REDUCE returns the final accumulation. Different rules can track net cost and gross cost without erasing credits from the source.

functions.name: SCAN
functions.arguments: Optional initial_value starts the accumulator; array supplies ordered values; lambda names accumulator and current value, then calculates the next accumulator.
functions.useCase: Track cumulative COPQ after each event.
functions.mistake: Input order matters. Credits stay negative unless the rule deliberately excludes them.

functions.name: REDUCE
functions.arguments: Optional initial_value starts the accumulator; array supplies values; lambda names accumulator and current value and returns the next accumulator.
functions.useCase: Total selected costs with a reusable rule.
functions.mistake: Start products at 1 and sums at 0. Unlike SCAN, only the final value is returned.

lesson.combine: Review IF, MAX and COUNTIFS. Start sums at zero and keep source order for running totals. Use a scalar LAMBDA body for each step. Any valid formula is accepted; submit unrounded CAD values.

tasks.prompt: Return cumulative net COPQ after each of the first ten events (10 × 1), retaining negative credits.
Return final net COPQ across all 50 events, including credits.
Return cumulative gross cost after each of the first ten events. Add positive costs; credits leave gross cost unchanged.
Return final gross cost across all 50 events, excluding negative credits.

bonus.prompt: Review COUNTIFS: count negative recovery-credit events.

columns.name: COPQ_CAD
columns.description: Positive cost or negative recovery credit, CAD.
